title: Contextual Rollout Sandbox & Safety Layers for Private Console
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Problem: Private/VPC customers need confidence when performing model or infra rollouts. Current console only allows basic canary percentages and a simple success/fail check which doesn't surface network topology, tenant-affinities, or cost/regional impact. This ticket proposes a Rollout Sandbox micro-surface and layered Safety controls integrated into the Private Console's cluster and rollout flows. The sandbox enables simulated rollout previews (latency heatmap, traffic shift, cache warm-up, and failure injection scenarios) and an inline safety panel for gateable approvals, automated rollback visibility, and cost delta estimation for a selected canary plan. Goals: 1) Provide a low-risk, discoverable preview for rollouts that shows real cluster topology and potential fallout (regions/zones affected). 2) Surface cost / perf delta estimates alongside canary configurations. 3) Offer safety layers: preflight checks, approval gates, dependency-aware scheduling (avoid nodes with running maintenance), and an automated rollback plan preview. 4) Keep interaction lightweight — microcards and inline expansions rather than full-page modals so operators can iterate quickly.
acceptance_criteria: Design mockups for the Rollout Sandbox microcard in cluster detail view (compact & expanded states).
Safety panel designs include: approval chain UI, preflight check list, and rollback preview card.
Prototype demonstrates simulated latency heatmap and cost-delta strip for a 10%, 25%, 50% canary across two regions.
Usability test (5 operators) shows >80% success rate completing a simulated canary plan and identifying a rollback condition.
Design handoff includes tokens/spacing, accessible colors for heatmap, and annotation of data dependencies required from ENG (metrics, topology API, cost estimator).
decisions: Inline microcard expansion preferred over modal to maintain context with cluster status and logs.
Show both model-level and infra-level preflight checks; preflight failures surfaced as blockers in the safety panel.
Cost-delta shown as an estimated range (low/median/high) with link to detailed cost explainer — avoids false precision.
Failure injection in sandbox is simulated only (no write operations) for safety; ops can promote to a real dry-run step handled by Dedicated/Private orchestration.
tradeoffs: Adding rich previews increases initial data fetches — we prefer lazy-loading extra telemetry when the sandbox is opened to minimize overhead.
Compact microcards limit space for textual explanations; we include a contextual help tooltip and a one-click deep-dive view if more explanation is needed.
Simulated failure fidelity vs. safety: we limit injected failures to common patterns (latency spike, connection loss to a single AZ) to avoid complex state machine simulation.
